request.text:
Ticket (personal data masked):
Is payroll down? Someone said it'll be fixed in 30 minutes, can you confirm the exact time?

Employee: Product Designer, Design, New York; MacBook Pro 14-inch (macOS 15).

Why the automated desk stopped: Decide did not clear it for self-service (escalate is 90% likely).

What the automated desk already did: screened the ticket and masked personal data; classified it as uncategorised, low severity; searched the knowledge base and kept 1 passage; drafted a reply and verified it (77% grounded).

Verified holding reply sent to the employee:
1. Expense claims can be submitted by email to the finance shared mailbox.
2. Updates are posted on the IT status page every two hours
request.instructions: You prepare escalations for a human IT technician. Use only the text. Do not suggest causes or fixes that are not stated.
